name: 充气轮减震折叠座骑滑板车款
description: 暗调气势开场、白底卖点、通勤骑行场景、轮胎微距与双配置对比的电动滑板车套图

styleLock.direction: cool-toned tech personal electric ride ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal textured panels #1A1A1D for hero and macro shots, seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot benefit and comparison screens, light neutral grey #F4F5F7 for spec and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio lighting, controlled directional key light, soft grounded contact shadows, subtle headlight glow used as the only warm element
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte asphalt-grey board #3A3A3E and seamless studio sweep, wheels always grounded
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold condensed headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and solid rounded rectangular label strips in a single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable side-profile hero silhouette, consistent product scale across the set, wheels grounded with soft contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-toned tech personal electric ride visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal textured background #1A1A1D, pure white #FFFFFF, light neutral grey #F4F5F7, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one electric blue accent #2F80ED; cool neutral studio lighting with controlled directional key light and soft grounded contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif bold condensed headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent rounded rectangular label strips in one accent color; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and grounded wheels with soft contact shadow and balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 低角度仰拍加暗调质感，一秒建立代步神器的气势与点击欲
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward, full product visible, slight 3/4 stance
shots.lighting: cool directional key from upper left, subtle front headlight glow, soft grounded shadow
shots.background: deep charcoal textured diagonal panel #1A1A1D with a clean off-white #F4F5F7 base strip at the bottom
shots.textZone: top center headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF, one oversized calligraphic accent word 「{callout_1}」 on the left in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: Dramatic hero shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward, full product visible in a slight 3/4 stance, headlight switched on with a subtle glow. Cool directional key light from the upper left, soft grounded contact shadow. Background of deep charcoal textured diagonal panels #1A1A1D with a clean off-white #F4F5F7 strip along the bottom. The product fills 60-70% of the frame in the lower two-thirds, while the upper third carries the typography: top center headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one oversized calligraphic accent word 「{callout_1}」 on the left in #FFFFFF, sized so the type and the silhouette never overlap. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no cars or luxury vehicles in the background, no fake brand logos on the product body, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 白底完整侧影承接点击，用大字卖点讲清核心利益
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, eye-level, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: top headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D, one accent sub-line 「{callout_1}」 in #2F80ED
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Clean 90-degree side profile at eye-level, full product visible with both wheels grounded. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product fills 60-70% of the frame in the lower two-thirds, with the typography block above it: top headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one accent sub-line 「{callout_1}」 in #2F80ED. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no dense body text, no more than one claim, no fake logo or brand decals, no watermark, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 让买家代入日常通勤画面，产品作为自由出行的主角
shots.camera: slightly low eye-level front three-quarter tracking view, mid shot of the rider in motion
shots.lighting: natural morning sunlight from the side, 5500K, gentle motion feel, soft shadows
shots.background: smooth urban bikeway with soft blurred greenery and pavement, cool neutral grey #C9CDD2
shots.props: a commuting backpack on the rider, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the open bikeway ahead and the blurred greenery
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} ridden along a smooth urban bikeway in the morning. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The rider wears a helmet and is seen from a back three-quarter angle with no recognizable face, one foot on the deck, mid shot in motion. Slightly low eye-level front three-quarter tracking view. Natural morning sunlight from the side, 5500K, soft shadows, gentle motion feel. Background of blurred pavement and greenery in cool neutral grey #C9CDD2 tones. A small commuting backpack on the rider, not covering the product. The rider and the product occupy 40-50% of the frame, with the open bikeway ahead giving natural breathing room. Negative: no visible face, no helmet-less rider, no hands covering the product, no invented speed or range data, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no traffic clutter.

shots.intent: 微距特写轮胎纹路与减震结构，证明行驶舒适的核心工艺
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a low angle, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing tire tread and fender texture, controlled highlights
shots.textZone: one short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF on the upper left with clean space
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the pneumatic tire, fender and suspension area of {product}, tight zoom on the tread pattern and shock structure. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing tire texture and metal finish, controlled highlights, soft shadow. Deep charcoal textured background #1A1A1D. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. One short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF on the upper left with clean space around it. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented shock-absorption test data, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated tire textures in the background.

shots.intent: 三格并列特写逐一证明车架、轮胎与踏板做工，结构化建立品质感
shots.camera: three matched close-up panels in a horizontal row, identical framing and scale across panels
shots.lighting: even soft studio light in all three panels, subtle raking light for texture, consistent direction
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF panels with a thin #2F80ED label strip under each panel
shots.whitespace: even white gutters between the three panels and their label strips
shots.textZone: one short label per panel on the accent strip: 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce three-panel detail grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three matched close-up panels in a horizontal row with identical framing and scale: left panel the wheel and tire, middle panel the folding stem and handlebar joint, right panel the deck surface. Even soft studio light in all panels, subtle raking light for texture, consistent direction. Pure white #FFFFFF panels, each with a thin #2F80ED label strip below carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF, separated by even white gutters. The detail fills 55-60% per panel. Clean structured layout. Negative: no mixed lighting between panels, no misaligned framing, no dense body text, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated background textures.

shots.intent: 左右同框对比两种配置，帮买家快速做出选择决定
shots.camera: two matched 90-degree side-profile panels, identical camera crop and scale on both sides
shots.lighting: identical bright even studio lighting on both panels, soft contact shadows
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF on both panels
shots.props: one small solid circular comparison badge in #2F80ED between the panels
shots.textZone: one short config label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, one accent badge between panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce configuration comparison of {product}, two matched panels with identical camera, crop, scale and lighting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: the product in the first configuration shown in a clean 90-degree side profile. Right panel: the product in the second configuration, same 90-degree side profile. Bright even studio lighting on both panels, soft contact shadows. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF on both panels. Each product fills 60-70% of its own panel with even margins. One short config label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, and one small solid circular badge in #2F80ED between the panels. Clean structured layout. Negative: no fabricated performance differences, no misaligned framing, no mixed lighting, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 编号信息图讲清结构与规格要点，消除尺寸与配置疑虑
shots.camera: slight front three-quarter view from a high 45-degree angle looking down, product upright
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: solid rounded label strips with thin #2F80ED edges and one numbered corner tag in #2F80ED
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the product and the label strips
shots.textZone: corner number tag in #2F80ED, core promise 「{selling_point_3}」 in #2D2D2D, and solid rounded label strips carrying 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic layout for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown upright at a slight front three-quarter view from a high 45-degree angle looking down, filling 60-70% of the frame. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Light neutral grey background #F4F5F7. Layout with one numbered corner tag in #2F80ED, a core promise 「{selling_point_3}」 in #2D2D2D, and two solid rounded label strips with thin #2F80ED edges carrying 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D pointing at the product's structure, all arranged with about 15% panel margins. Clean structured layout. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no dense body text, no invented specs, range, speed or certification numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 用可见的用料做工细节加售后承诺标签降低购买风险
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, product centered, weld joints and deck edge rendered crisply
shots.textZone: two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown straight-on at eye-level and centered, filling 50-60% of the frame, with its welded frame joints, reinforced deck edge and solid folding latch rendered in crisp detail as the visible trust focus. Even clean high-key studio light, soft contact shadow. Pure white background #FFFFFF. Two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D sit beside the product. Clean structured layout. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test reports or warranty numbers, no fabricated badge artwork, no dense certificate textures, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 回到暗调气势镜头收口促单，左侧文案与实底按钮完成转化
shots.camera: slightly low front three-quarter hero angle, product on the right half
shots.lighting: cool directional key light with subtle headlight glow, punchier contrast, soft grounded shadow
shots.props: one solid rounded CTA button in #2F80ED
shots.textZone: left half headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF, one solid rounded CTA button in #2F80ED with short label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product fills 60-70% of the right half at a slightly low front three-quarter hero angle, headlight glow subtle, wheels grounded. Cool directional key light, punchier contrast, soft grounded contact shadow. Deep charcoal textured background #1A1A1D. The left half carries the conversion block: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF above one solid rounded CTA button in #2F80ED with a short label 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF. Clean decisive layout. Negative: no invented discounts, countdowns or sales numbers, no fake brand logos, no QR code, no extra text, no watermark, no floating product, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 6 张爆款电动滑板车详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源车身贴字与品牌字样、书法大字文案、二维码、会员促销块、背景豪车素材及错位的USB车充文案；产品一律以 {product} 占位，骑手仅保留佩戴头盔不露脸的角色。
